| description = Exactly 16 minute, 30 second spawn timer. Social aggro to most mobs in the room. Recommended level 33 for a Druid trying to solo, but doable at 29. Check the [[Paw of Opolla Quest]] for detailed camp information.

Note (7/23/2021): I started killing the mutant as a level 33 Druid and was able to completely avoid aggroing any other mobs in the room, contrary to what the wiki page for paw quest would tell you. I just backed myself into the corner where the mutant fungus spawns and started blasting away with Combust. Takes about 4 casts to get him down, you may take a bit of damage and a clockwork poison or two but he goes down easy. I did this close to a dozen times and not once did I get an additional mob jumping on me. It's possible you could get bad timing with a roamer, but if that happens just make sure you have gate memmed and are bound just outside of Guk; kill the fungus, gate out, and avoid any additional faction hits. If you are a lower level then your aggro range may be increased, so while I'm sure this works at level 33, I can't say that it will for anyone lower level. Good luck!
